Done. Written to `operations/command/records/analyses/cross-system-adoption-priorities.md`.

**The top 10, by leverage:**

1. **In-process hook execution** — saves 250-1000ms per tool call, makes everything else faster (small-medium)
2. **Reflection-on-failure** — "why did this fail?" stored with instincts, prevents repeat failures (medium)
3. **Structured session save/resume** — what worked/failed/next step survives session boundaries (small)
4. **Autonomous memory consolidation** — nightly dreaming promotes instincts, prunes stale memories (medium)
5. **Loop detection** — signature-based, catches stuck agents before they burn the budget (small)
6. **Progressive skill disclosure** — three-layer loading keeps context lean as skills grow (medium)
7. **Heartbeat monitoring** — periodic self-check catches stale plans, failed sessions without human (medium)
8. **Structured compaction template** — prevents context loss during long autonomous sessions (small-medium)
9. **Entity lifecycle hooks** — auto-validate on create, auto-cleanup on destruct (medium)
10. **Origin tracking** — tag every tool call with who caused it for debugging and security (small-medium)

The implementation sequence groups them: infrastructure speed (1, 5), session management (3, 8), learning loop (2, 4), operational maturity (6, 7, 9, 10). Items 1 and 5 have zero dependencies and can start immediately.
